_comment: The Terminal's own patterns (task O1; GDD §5, Zone 8). Its levels name this file as their patterns_path, so the
generator picks from this folder only: none of the core patterns' holes, fences and signs, and none of the usual
enemies (the owner, October 20, 2026: only the Cybernetic Centipede, GDD §9.15, still to be built). Its couple of
holes are the levels' wider gaps (LevelConfig.wide_gaps 2: rows in every lane but one), and its ceilings are few
and one lane wide (the levels' narrow_ceiling_share and one_lane_ceiling_share 1; a plain ceiling pattern, so a
one-lane ceiling may come of it). open_track is a stretch of the track the pattern pass leaves to the doodads,
with a trail of credits along one lane; its weight against the ceiling's sets how few ceilings come.
DESIGN-TBD (docs/questions/o1.md): the weights, the open stretch's length and its credits. Tasks O2 (the debris
maze) and O3 (the centipede) add their patterns here, requiring `debris_maze` and `centipede`.
Metres are at the reference speed (18 m/s), stretched by the level's pace, as in data/patterns/README.md.
